text.tspan: Always: searchavo-web, searchavo and searchavo-backoffice Deployments (RollingUpdate maxSurge 1,
maxUnavailable 0, spread by hostname), the migrate Job of the release, postgres and redis
StatefulSets (one replica, RWO volume; postgres: startup probe up to 10 min, then liveness;
redis: liveness after 30 s), ServiceAccount searchavo without token,
new pods ready one at a time
missed if it cannot start within an hour;
PVC kept on uninstall, one dump per run,
the dumps of the newest 7 dates,
rclone crypt, then copy the new dump to R2;
newest dump (R2 with offsite, else the PVC
read-only) into its own Postgres on an emptyDir;
ON_ERROR_STOP, Flyway rows, tables not empty;
egress 443 only with offsite, never Postgres
